fr:mainmatter.html:p: Goal: land the Agda formalization of double categories, double functors, 2-categories, and their main instances in um-catlab/cubical-categorical-logic as a sequence of topic-scoped PRs — one PR per concept (definitions, functors, instances, …), reconciled against the thickened-displayed-categories work in PR 253.

Why a milestone. The material currently lives across a stack of feature branches (2-cat, double-cat, double-cat-instances, double-categories, displayed-double-cat, thick-displayed-categories, plus exploratory branches like bicategory-experiment and investigate-2cat-double-examples). Max wants the stack repackaged so each PR addresses a single concept, instead of the current accidental groupings. This milestone tracks that re-slicing without further entangling it with other ongoing work.

Reconciliation point. The displayed double category construction needs to be expressed against the thickened displayed categories of PR 253 (Cubical/Categories/Displayed/Thick/Base.agda, plus the MappingCylinder HIT and the freely-adjoined-identity construction). Until 253 lands, the displayed-double-cat branch's WIP instance (Cubical/Categories/Double/Instances/Displayed.agda, currently with holes) is the natural client and stress test.
